method: Counters and first256 chronological source-level function entries in an ignored diagnostic build. Includes entries later inlined by O3, not a WASM call count. Constructors and input submission are excluded; counters reset immediately before capture. Integer board time is ps for CLKI and oscillator half ticks for compatible firmware. No host timestamps or per-edge JS callbacks. Instrumentation changes executable code, layout and performance: its times are never used as production performance or sampling percentages. Final full public/data/Flash/EEPROM/IRQ state and raw PCM must match an uninstrumented production reference.
